Ravager.tagline: Sustained melee assassin — huge single-target DPS.
Ravager.overview: Ravager blends the Greatsword's heavy AoE pressure with the Dagger's critical-hit burst. It plays like a bruiser that snowballs into a melee assassin: build up Heavy Attack chance and crit through the fight, then chain Dagger combos into finishers while your target is crowd-controlled.
weaknesses: Limited AoE compared to pure Greatsword builds
Ravager.stat_priority: Strength (primary) > Dexterity (secondary) — Strength scales damage & HP via Vital Force, Dexterity raises Heavy Attack and crit chance.
perks: Vital Force (Greatsword passive) — bonus HP and damage scaling from Strength
Cold Warrior (Greatsword passive) — enhanced damage while target is debuffed
Merciless Form (Dagger passive) — attack speed and bonus damage after landing crits
Prioritize Critical Hit Chance / Critical Damage runes on both weapons
Ravager.rotation: Open with a Greatsword gap-closer + CC, weave in Dagger backstab/positional skills for crit, finish with your hardest-hitting combo while the target is stunned.
Ravager.best_for: Dungeon bosses, PvE single-target DPS, small-scale PvP assassination.

Crusader.tagline: Frontline threat generator with real damage output.
Crusader.overview: Crusader swaps pure survivability for a more offensive tank profile. Sword & Shield anchors your defense and threat, while the Greatsword adds genuine AoE damage so you're not just a punching bag in group content.
strengths: Good AoE damage for a tank
weaknesses: Less pure survivability than a full Sword & Shield build
Crusader.stat_priority: Strength (primary) > Constitution — balance damage scaling with enough HP/defense to hold aggro.
perks: Shield Bash / taunt line skills to lock down threat
Block-focused passives from Sword & Shield mastery
Defense runes on the Shield, damage runes on the Greatsword
Crusader.rotation: Open with taunt/CC to secure aggro, cycle block and defensive cooldowns, weave Greatsword AoE between mitigation windows.
Crusader.best_for: Dungeon and raid tanking where the group also needs extra damage.

Warden.tagline: The classic, most durable tank build.
Warden.overview: Warden is the go-to pure defensive tank. Sword & Shield provides the bulk of your mitigation and CC while Longbow gives you a way to peel, kite, and apply ranged utility when melee range isn't ideal.
weaknesses: Longbow is mostly utility here, not a damage focus
Warden.stat_priority: Constitution (primary) > Perception/Dexterity — stack HP and defense first, then just enough offense to stay relevant.
perks: Crowd-control chain skills (stuns/knockdowns) for group safety
Longbow utility skills for ranged pulls and kiting
Defense and HP runes on Sword & Shield
Warden.rotation: Pull with Longbow if needed, taunt on engage, cycle block/CC to control adds and protect the healer.
Warden.best_for: Guild raids, world bosses, and any content that demands maximum survivability.

Berserker.overview: Berserker trades some of Warden's raw durability for burst and mobility, using the Dagger to punish exposed targets while still leaning on the Shield for block and CC.
strengths: Good burst for a tank archetype
weaknesses: Squishier than a pure Shield build
Berserker.stat_priority: Strength/Dexterity (offense) balanced with enough Constitution to survive.
perks: Merciless Form (Dagger) for post-crit attack speed
Positional Dagger skills for bonus damage from flank/rear
Berserker.rotation: Engage with Shield CC, swap to Dagger for burst on a controlled target, fall back to block when cooldowns are down.
Berserker.best_for: Small-scale PvP and solo/duo open-world play.

Raider.tagline: Ranged-poke tank with strong pull/CC utility.
Raider.overview: Raider keeps the Shield's defensive core but swaps the offhand for Crossbow, giving you ranged burst windows and pull utility before enemies ever reach melee range.
strengths: Good burst damage for a tank
weaknesses: Crossbow stamina management can be tricky
Raider.stat_priority: Constitution first, Dexterity second for Crossbow burst windows.
perks: Crossbow burst/pull skills to control engagements
Raider.rotation: Pull with Crossbow, taunt on contact, alternate block phases with Crossbow burst windows.
Raider.best_for: Open-world skirmishes and flexible group tanking.

Templar.tagline: The premier tank/healer hybrid — unmatched party sustain.
Templar.overview: Templar pairs the Shield's mitigation with the Wand's healing and debuff toolkit, making it one of the strongest support-tank hybrids in the game — equally frustrating to fight in PvP and invaluable in PvE.
Templar.stat_priority: Constitution/Wisdom balance — enough HP to tank, enough Wisdom for healing throughput.
perks: Debuff-focused Wand nodes to weaken enemy damage
Templar.rotation: Hold aggro with Shield skills, weave Wand heals/cleanses on cooldown, use debuffs to reduce incoming damage on the party.
Templar.best_for: Guild wars, sieges, and any content wanting a tank that can also heal.

Disciple.tagline: Defensive caster hybrid — utility over raw healing.
Disciple.overview: Disciple leans on the Shield for protection while using the Staff's elemental kit for ranged pressure and utility, playing more like a battle-mage support than a dedicated healer.
weaknesses: Not a primary healer or primary tank
perks: Utility-focused Staff nodes over pure damage nodes
Disciple.rotation: Anchor on Shield defense, poke with Staff spells, peel for allies when needed.
Disciple.best_for: Flexible group support roles and solo open-world content.

Seeker.tagline: Ranged healer with moderate DPS on the side.
Seeker.overview: Seeker uses the Wand as its healing core and the Longbow to contribute meaningful single-target damage and cleanses between heals — a strong pick for players who want to heal without feeling purely passive.
strengths: Solid healing plus real damage contribution
weaknesses: Lower burst-heal ceiling than Wand + Tome pure healer builds
Seeker.stat_priority: Wisdom (primary) > Perception — healing power first, then damage/utility.
Seeker.rotation: Maintain HoTs with the Wand, weave Longbow shots for damage and cleanses, burst-heal with cooldowns during danger phases.
Seeker.best_for: Dungeon and raid healing where the group also wants ranged pressure.

Fury.tagline: Mobile burst caster with a wide AoE kit.
Fury.overview: Fury is a DPS-focused caster that mixes the Crossbow's rapid bursts with the Wand's elemental and curse damage. It excels at high-mobility fights where you need to keep moving and still deal consistent AoE.
weaknesses: Lower single-target ceiling than pure Wand/Staff builds
perks: Dark Apostacy (Wand mastery) for AoE curse/elemental damage
Crossbow burst-fire skills for windows of extra damage
Elemental/curse damage runes on the Wand
Fury.rotation: Open with Wand AoE curses, weave Crossbow bursts on cooldown, reposition constantly to keep uptime.
Fury.best_for: Open-world AoE farming and mobile PvP skirmishes.

Battleweaver.tagline: Elemental ranged DPS with strong burst windows.
Battleweaver.overview: Battleweaver combines the Staff's elemental spellcasting with the Crossbow's rapid-fire bursts for a ranged caster/gunner hybrid that can flex between sustained and burst damage.
perks: Cooldown reduction and elemental damage runes
Battleweaver.rotation: Kite while stacking Staff AoE, burst with Crossbow when the target is locked down.
Battleweaver.best_for: PvE trash clearing and ranged PvP poke comps.

Invocator.tagline: Pure spellcaster — the highest magic damage ceiling.
Invocator.overview: Invocator is a full caster build with no melee weapon at all. It stacks Staff elemental damage with the Wand's curse/Dark Apostacy line for one of the most versatile and highest-damage ranged setups in the game.
weaknesses: No mobility or defensive weapon skills
perks: Dark Apostacy (Wand mastery) for AoE/curse damage
Invocator.rotation: Layer DoTs and AoE curses, refresh them on cooldown, burst single targets with high-damage spell combos.
Invocator.best_for: Farming, sustained boss DPS, and AoE-heavy PvE content.

Liberator.tagline: Ranged support/DPS hybrid with strong utility.
Liberator.overview: Liberator blends Longbow precision with Staff utility, offering ranged damage alongside crowd control and support tools rather than committing fully to either healing or pure DPS.
Liberator.rotation: Control the fight with Staff CC, chip damage with Longbow, reposition to stay at range.
Liberator.best_for: Flexible ranged support in dungeons and open-world groups.

Paladin.tagline: Melee support build — damage with real healing utility.
Paladin.overview: Paladin fights in melee with the Greatsword but carries the Wand for self-sustain and party support, making it a strong pick for players who want to be in the thick of the fight while still helping the team survive.
weaknesses: Mana management while fighting in melee
Paladin.rotation: Fight in melee with Greatsword combos, weave in Wand heals during lulls, cleanse debuffs off yourself or allies.
Paladin.best_for: Solo and small-group play where you need both damage and self-sufficiency.

Sentinel.tagline: Melee-magic hybrid with strong AoE and crowd control.
Sentinel.overview: Sentinel weaves Staff spells into a Greatsword-based melee rotation, giving you ranged pressure to soften targets before closing in for heavy AoE damage — great crowd control, if a bit unfocused on bosses.
weaknesses: Lower single-target boss damage than pure melee builds
perks: Staff elemental AoE for pre-engage damage
Crowd control skills from both weapons
Sentinel.rotation: Open at range with Staff AoE, close in with Greatsword CC and heavy hits, retreat to range if overwhelmed.
Sentinel.best_for: Trash-clearing, AoE-heavy dungeons, and group PvP zerg fights.

Outrider.tagline: Melee DPS with a ranged poke fallback.
Outrider.overview: Outrider uses Crossbow poke to soften targets at range, then dives in with the Greatsword to finish the job — flexible engagement range with strong burst once in melee.
weaknesses: Mediocre at long range compared to pure ranged builds
Outrider.rotation: Poke with Crossbow while closing distance, transition into Greatsword combos on arrival.
Outrider.best_for: Open-world PvP and fights where target distance varies.

Ranger.tagline: Hybrid melee/ranged DPS with strong burst and sustain.
Ranger.overview: Ranger pairs the Longbow's mobility and sustained damage with the Greatsword's burst potential and AoE, letting you kite when needed and commit to melee when you can land a full combo.
weaknesses: Jack-of-both-trades — not the top pick in either pure range or pure melee
Ranger.rotation: Kite with Longbow to build damage, close in with Greatsword for burst finishers.
Ranger.best_for: PvE team DPS and versatile open-world play.

Infiltrator.overview: Infiltrator engages from range with the Longbow, then closes for a brutal Dagger finisher — excellent for picking off priority targets in PvP with high mobility and burst.
weaknesses: Fragile if caught out of position
perks: Merciless Form (Dagger) for post-crit attack speed
Critical hit and critical damage runes
Infiltrator.rotation: Open with Longbow shots to soften, gap-close with a Dagger burst combo, disengage if the fight turns.
Infiltrator.best_for: Small-scale PvP and quick, mobile PvE encounters.

Scout.tagline: Pure ranged DPS — no melee weapon at all.
Scout.overview: Scout commits fully to ranged combat, mixing the Crossbow's rapid bursts with the Longbow's sustained precision damage for a build that never has to enter melee range.
weaknesses: No melee fallback if closed on
Needs good kiting skill to shine
Scout.rotation: Kite continuously, alternate Crossbow bursts with Longbow sustained fire, reposition after every few hits.
Scout.best_for: Ranged PvP poke comps and safe PvE damage from a distance.

Scorpion.tagline: Deadly burst combo — high skill ceiling, high reward.
Scorpion.overview: Scorpion is one of the highest damage-output combos in the game, mixing Crossbow rapid bursts with Dagger crit finishers. It rewards good reflexes and target tracking with devastating single-target burst.
perks: Merciless Form (Dagger) for post-crit attack speed
Critical hit chance/damage runes on both weapons
Scorpion.rotation: Open with Crossbow burst to soften, weave Dagger crits for the kill window, reset if the target survives.
Scorpion.best_for: High-skill PvP duels and single-target PvE burst checks.

Darkblighter.tagline: Stealthy burst caster/assassin — deadly single-target PvP.
Darkblighter.overview: Darkblighter mixes Dagger stealth and burst with Wand curses and elemental damage, making it a strong single-target assassin build with PvP utility from crowd control and debuffs.
perks: Dark Apostacy (Wand mastery) for curse/elemental damage
Merciless Form (Dagger) for post-crit attack speed
Debuff-focused Wand nodes to weaken your target
Darkblighter.rotation: Debuff and curse the target from range or stealth, close in with Dagger for the burst finisher.

Spellblade.tagline: Melee-magic hybrid — fast, versatile, high mobility.
Spellblade.overview: Spellblade pairs Staff spellcasting with Dagger speed and burst for a fast, magic-infused melee playstyle that's equally comfortable farming or dueling.
weaknesses: Split stat investment between Intelligence and Dexterity
Lower peak single-target DPS than dedicated crit builds
perks: Merciless Form (Dagger) for post-crit attack speed
Staff elemental burst and AoE skills
Spellblade.rotation: Open with a Staff spell for damage/CC, follow up with Dagger crit combos, reposition for the next opener.
Spellblade.best_for: Farming and versatile solo PvE/PvP play.

Gladiator.tagline: Reach-focused melee DPS with strong AoE.
Gladiator.overview: A newer weapon-combo build that pairs the Greatsword's heavy AoE with the Spear's reach and crowd control, trading some single-target burst for consistent group-fight AoE pressure.
weaknesses: Boss (single-target) damage lags behind top-tier melee builds
perks: Spear reach/CC skills to control multiple targets
Gladiator.rotation: Use Spear reach to CC groups, follow with Greatsword AoE sweeps.
Gladiator.best_for: Large-scale PvP zerg fights and AoE trash clearing.
